login.title: Jules,
login.subtitle: your dev agents, under your control.
login.lede: Sign in with your GitHub account. Only members of this instance have access.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.empty_text: Mention Jules in a GitHub issue, or create a task here.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.created: Task created: Jules opens the GitHub issue.

task.sent: Command sent: Jules is checking it.
task.answer_title: Jules is waiting for your answer
task.answer_placeholder: Answer the questions above: Jules resumes the task with your answer.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.empty_text: Specs and designs waiting for your go-ahead will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.secret_saved: Secret sealed for the worker: it can no longer be read here.
settings.write_only: Write-only: once saved, a secret is never shown again.
settings.passkeys_desktop: Register your passkeys in your server's web interface: the app uses them through your browser.
settings.passkeys_local: In local mode, sensitive actions are confirmed in a system window, without a passkey.

stepup.title: Confirm with your passkey
stepup.text: This action is sensitive: Jules asks for your passkey, even with an open session.
stepup.none: Add a passkey in settings first.
stepup.browser_text: This action is sensitive. The app's webview has no passkey support: confirmation opens in your browser, on your Jules server. Come back here afterwards, the action carries on by itself.

stop.title: Stop every run?
stop.text: Sandboxes are killed, tokens revoked, and nothing restarts until an admin lifts the stop with a passkey.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.empty: No task in this period yet.

servers.title: Servers
servers.name: Name
servers.key_help: Sealed for the worker on receipt: it will never be shown again.
servers.saved: Server registered: Jules is reading its host key.
servers.validate_help: Compare it with the output of “ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub” on the server, then copy it here.
servers.empty_text: Register a server so the DevOps agent can diagnose it.

plan.title: Change plan
plan.sent: Decision sent: Jules is checking it.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.empty_text: Declare deploy.staging and deploy.production in .jules/config.yml, and a deploy playbook.

notify.approval: An approval is waiting for you.

security.title: Security
security.accept_help: Passkey required; the finding reopens at the end date.
security.audit_sent: Audit requested: the worker runs it.
security.empty_text: Scheduled audits, merges and on-demand audits feed this list.

org.title: Organisation
org.four_eyes_help: The approver of a production plan must be someone other than the requester.
org.github_prod_help: Off by default: a comment cannot ask for a passkey.

desktop.subtitle: on your desktop.
desktop.waiting_browser: Finish signing in in your browser…
desktop.update_text: This app ({{version}}) is too old for this server, which requires at least version {{minimum}}. Install the update to continue.
desktop.mode_local_text: Local mode: Jules runs here, on your git folders, without GitHub.
desktop.mode_server_text: Connected mode: the app connects to your team's server.
desktop.engine_missing: Neither Docker nor Podman is installed
desktop.engine_help: Local mode runs Jules in containers. Install one of them, start it, then retry.
desktop.access_intro: Jules needs access to the model to run its agents. It is kept in the system keychain, never in a file or in the database, and handed to the worker each time it starts.

access_text.subscription: With your Claude subscription (Pro or Max), for your personal use only. In a terminal, run the command below, sign in, then paste the token it prints. When your subscription reaches its limit, tasks wait until it lifts.
access_text.api_key: With an API key from the Claude Console, billed per use.

isolation_text.gvisor: Agents run under gVisor, as on a Jules server.
isolation_text.vm: Agents run in the Docker Desktop or Podman VM, without gVisor. For a sensitive repo, prefer a Jules server.
isolation_text.runc: Agents run in a plain container, without gVisor or a VM: weak isolation. Install gVisor (runsc) or use a Jules server.

local.no_repos: No folder yet: add a git folder to give Jules a task.
local.merged: Merged ({{sha}}): the folder's base branch is up to date.
local.access_text: Kept in the system keychain: Jules never shows it. Replacing it restarts the worker; a run in progress is interrupted.
local.access_replaced: Access replaced, the worker has it.
local.repos_help: A git folder with at least one commit: Jules works on branches and never touches your files in progress.

stepup_page.subtitle: confirm an action.
stepup_page.text: The Jules app asks for your passkey for this action:
stepup_page.done: Confirmed. Go back to the Jules app: the action carries on.
stepup_page.no_passkey: No passkey on your account. Sign in to the web interface, add a passkey in Settings, then reload this page: the request stays valid for 5 minutes.
